issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must define \alpha_t using historical information up to iteration t-1 to ensure measurability with respect to \mathcal{F}_{t-1}, or control the covariance between \alpha_t and \g_t, and re-establish the tracking error recursion without dropping non-zero cross-terms.
issues.overall_effect: The tracking error bound on \EEE[\|\s_t\|^2] fails, which breaks the subsequent bounds on the cumulative tracking error, objective value, and gradient norms, ultimately invalidating the convergence guarantee for OptEMA-M in Theorem 12.
issues.title: Invalid tracking error recurrence via omitted cross-term and non-measurable EMA weight in OptEMA-M
issues.why_classification: The failure invalidates the main theoretical result for OptEMA-M (Theorem 12). Resolving it requires changing the definition of the algorithmic EMA weights or introducing a new proof architecture to handle non-measurable adaptive weights.
